title: Couch TV broadcast spec
description: Generated by `npm run schema` in clients/broadcast from src/spec.ts. Do not edit. One spec per cutscene template, or a break (its sound only).

loudness.description: Integrated loudness (ITU-R BS.1770) the audio render is normalized to, in LUFS; the true peak stays at or under -1 dBTP even when that leaves it quieter.

cut.description: The full cut (10.52 s, before the prime-time movie) or the short one (4.52 s).

posters.description: Poster image URLs (2:3) the brackets frame, in order: the full cut shows four, the short cut one; fewer repeat, none shows a stand-in card.

loudness.description: Integrated loudness (ITU-R BS.1770) the audio render is normalized to, in LUFS; the true peak stays at or under -1 dBTP even when that leaves it quieter.

duration.description: Seconds, a whole number of frames; the library is 2, 3 and 5 s and the hold absorbs anything in between.

StingSpec.description: A gap filler in the ident's language: the lockup landing on the hook.

loudness.description: Integrated loudness (ITU-R BS.1770) the audio render is normalized to, in LUFS; the true peak stays at or under -1 dBTP even when that leaves it quieter.

clock.description: The corner bug's clock; no bug without it.

enter.description: `continue` picks up a picture that is already on screen (after a squeeze).

UpNextSpec.description: The next program, counting down into it.

name.description: The name as shown (English where the title has it).

logo.description: The title's logo in the language of `name` (else one not tied to a language), which a template draws in place of the name where it shows the title big; absent, the name is set in type.

footage.description: Scenes from the title, in order (its footage shots), for the screens that show it in motion; absent, they show its artwork.

genres.description: English genre labels, most significant first.

accents.description: The server-extracted artwork accents; the more chromatic one colours the template.

taglines.description: Short English lines for promos, in order (the tagline, split).

Title.description: A title as the templates show it.

url.description: A PNG trimmed to its visible pixels, transparent around the letters.

focus.description: The part of the frame to keep in view when it is cropped (default: all of it).

FootageShot.description: Real footage: one shot's frames as 25 fps JPEG URLs, shown frame by frame.

Crop.description: A normalized crop of an image: `[x, y, width, height]`, each 0..1.

TitleCrops.description: Framing for a title's backdrop per use: Ken Burns moves are `[from, to]`.

url.description: The audio file. Use WAV, FLAC or Ogg Opus (every Chromium decodes them; the open-source builds have no AAC). `synth:groove`, `synth:pulse` and `synth:drone` are built-in placeholder beds.

in.description: Where the excerpt starts in the file, seconds.

out.description: Where it ends, seconds; templates never play past it.

gain.description: Linear gain on top of the template's own level.

Bed.description: An excerpt of a soundtrack the template plays under itself (a bed).

loudness.description: Integrated loudness (ITU-R BS.1770) the audio render is normalized to, in LUFS; the true peak stays at or under -1 dBTP even when that leaves it quieter.

premiere.description: The premiere variant (D24): a premiere card in the body, `Premiere` on the end card.

shots.description: The shots, used in order and cycled; footage cuts on the bed's beats.

hero.description: The shot under the title wordmark (default: the next one).

words.description: Kinetic words for the body; timeless only (a genre, the year). Defaults from the title.

airing.description: The end card's airing (the body ignores it); absent, the end card is the evergreen one.

PromoSpec.description: A promo: a timeless body (rendered once per title) and a 4 s end card with the airing. A clip is one `part`; the break's audio renders `full`, so the bed runs across the cut.

StillShot.description: A still: a crop of the title's artwork with a slow move from one crop to another.

day.description: A day shown before the time on end cards (`Saturday`); empty or absent for none.

Airing.description: When something airs, formatted in English by the server.

loudness.description: Integrated loudness (ITU-R BS.1770) the audio render is normalized to, in LUFS; the true peak stays at or under -1 dBTP even when that leaves it quieter.

premiere.description: The premiere variant (D24): a premiere card in the body, `Premiere` on the end card.

shots.description: The shots, used in order and cycled; footage cuts on the bed's beats.

hero.description: The shot under the title wordmark (default: the next one).

words.description: Kinetic words for the body; timeless only (a genre, the year). Defaults from the title.

EvergreenEndSpec.description: The evergreen end card ("Coming up on Couch TV") after a promo body, for fallback breaks.

loudness.description: Integrated loudness (ITU-R BS.1770) the audio render is normalized to, in LUFS; the true peak stays at or under -1 dBTP even when that leaves it quieter.

day.description: A day shown before the time on end cards (`Saturday`); empty or absent for none.

foot.description: The line under the days: the episode count or the start of a season.

StripPromoSpec.description: A strip ("Every weekday at 18:00"): the days light up on the beat.

Weekday.description: A day of the week, 0 = Monday.

loudness.description: Integrated loudness (ITU-R BS.1770) the audio render is normalized to, in LUFS; the true peak stays at or under -1 dBTP even when that leaves it quieter.

ShortPromoSpec.description: A short promo on the bed's first hit ("Tomorrow 21:00 INVINCIBLE").

loudness.description: Integrated loudness (ITU-R BS.1770) the audio render is normalized to, in LUFS; the true peak stays at or under -1 dBTP even when that leaves it quieter.

state.description: `live` (on now) or `next`; one row at most has either.

badge.description: The `next` row's pill, preformatted: `Next · in 12 min`.

progress.description: How far the live program is.

loudness.description: Integrated loudness (ITU-R BS.1770) the audio render is normalized to, in LUFS; the true peak stays at or under -1 dBTP even when that leaves it quieter.

clock.description: The corner bug's clock; no bug without it.

handover.description: `expand` (11.52 s): the next picture grows to full frame; `cursor` (10.6 s): the program collapses into the red cursor block the short ident opens on, its last frame the ident's first.

bed.description: The program's own sound from the credits, ducked under "Up next".

SqueezeSpec.description: The credits squeeze: the program shrinks into a panel and "Up next" fills the rest.

kind.description: A solid black hole for an ffmpeg composite (`keyRect`, the `matte` layer).
The program's last seconds (from the credits) as 25 fps JPEG frames.
The ending title's backdrop under a credits roll (the admin preview).

ProgramSource.description: What fills the squeezed program panel.

loudness.description: Integrated loudness (ITU-R BS.1770) the audio render is normalized to, in LUFS; the true peak stays at or under -1 dBTP even when that leaves it quieter.

StandbySpec.description: "Technical difficulties": loops seamlessly, picture and sound, until the next airing.

loudness.description: Integrated loudness (ITU-R BS.1770) the audio render is normalized to, in LUFS; the true peak stays at or under -1 dBTP even when that leaves it quieter.

duration.description: Seconds, a whole number of frames: the length of the break's weather slot.

asOf.description: When the forecast was read, on the channel's clock.

warnings.description: Yellow, orange and red warnings in force now or later that day, the most severe first; empty on a quiet day, absent while ČHMÚ cannot be read.

WeatherSpec.description: The weather: every configured city now and over the next days, and ČHMÚ's warnings.

name.description: As the config names it (`Prague`, `České Budějovice`).

lat.description: Where it is, degrees north (WGS 84): `czechiaMap` (core/geo.ts) places it on the outline.

days.description: Today and the days after it, in order.

WeatherCity.description: One place of the weather map, in the order the channel's config lists them.

day.description: Daylight: a sun rather than a moon.

WeatherNow.description: The weather at the bulletin's time.

WmoCode.description: A WMO weather code as Open-Meteo reports it: 0 clear, 1 mainly clear, 2 partly cloudy, 3 overcast, 45 and 48 fog, 51-57 drizzle, 61-67 rain, 71-77 snow, 80-82 rain showers, 85 and 86 snow showers, 95-99 thunderstorms.

label.description: `Today`, `Tomorrow`, then the weekday (`Thursday`), from the bulletin's day.

code.description: The weather of the daytime, 09-18 (not the day's worst hour).

precipitation.description: The day's highest chance of precipitation, %; absent when the forecast has none.

event.description: ČHMÚ's English name of the event, `Moderate Wind Related Impact`.

active.description: In force when the bulletin was made; otherwise it begins later that day.

from.description: When it begins (the earliest of its areas; past when it is active).

until.description: When it ends (the latest of its areas); absent: until further notice.

WeatherWarning.description: One of ČHMÚ's warnings: an event at a level over the kraje it covers.

day.description: The English weekday (`Wednesday`) when it is another day than the bulletin's; absent on that day.

BulletinTime.description: A moment a bulletin names: a clock time, with its day when that is not the bulletin's own.

partial.description: Only some of its districts are warned.

KrajCode.description: A kraj (region) of Czechia, by its ISO 3166-2 code.

forecast.description: `Weather data by Open-Meteo.com` (CC BY 4.0): always on screen.

warnings.description: `Source: ČHMÚ`: on screen whenever the warnings, or their absence, are.

borders.description: `Borders: ČÚZK / geoBoundaries (CC BY 4.0)`: on screen whenever the map is drawn.

WeatherCredits.description: The credits the sources' terms ask for, each on screen whenever its data is.

loudness.description: Integrated loudness (ITU-R BS.1770) the audio render is normalized to, in LUFS; the true peak stays at or under -1 dBTP even when that leaves it quieter.

duration.description: Seconds, a whole number of frames: the length of the break's news slot.

asOf.description: When the headlines were read, on the channel's clock.

credit.description: The credit line, on screen throughout: `Headlines from the outlets’ RSS feeds, as of 17:40`.

NewsSpec.description: The news: the top stories of the last hours, most important first.

headline.description: The outlet's own headline in Czech, whole and unaltered: the outlets' terms forbid shortening, rewording or translating it. A no-break space follows one-letter words, so it wraps as Czech typesetting does; fit it, never cut it.

outlet.description: The outlet's name, shown with the headline as plain text, never as a logo: `ČT24`, `iROZHLAS`, `Seznam Zprávy`, `Novinky.cz`, `iDNES.cz`.

outlets.description: How many outlets carry the story.

trending.description: Among ČT24's most read of the day.

loudness.description: Integrated loudness (ITU-R BS.1770) the audio render is normalized to, in LUFS; the true peak stays at or under -1 dBTP even when that leaves it quieter.

crossfade.description: Seconds the outgoing clip's sound fades under the incoming one.

BreakSpec.description: A whole break's sound in one render: clips in sequence, each ringing out under the next.

at.description: Where the clip starts in the break, seconds (a whole number of frames).
